title: D5-5a N01: Maximum Safe Recovery for High-Sulfate Summer Seawater
question_prompt:
D5-5a N01: Maximum Safe Recovery for High-Sulfate Summer Seawater

A SWRO plant sees elevated Ca/SO4 in summer. Acidification is fixed, and operations want more permeate without changing chemicals. Use equilibrate_feed and vary only water recovery. Find (1) the maximum recovery at which all specified minerals have SI<0 and (2) the maximum recommended recovery with the controlling mineral at SI≤-0.05. Prove both limits with adjacent pass/fail points at 0.1 percentage-point resolution.

reference_answer:
D5-5a N01: Stepwise Gold Answer — Maximum Safe Recovery for High-Sulfate Summer Seawater

Reference efficient trajectory: 8 equilibrate_feed calls: 0.3000 → 0.5500 → 0.4500 → 0.5000 → 0.4960 → 0.4970 → 0.4460 → 0.4470. Alternative rational bracketing orders are acceptable, but both the basic and recommended-margin boundaries must be proven.
